steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Discount. Each cash flow is discounted at the stated rate, then net present value is recomputed.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Discount rate with no basis
findings.fix: State the basis for the rate

findings.title: Cash flow with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the flow

findings.title: Result does not match the recomputation

outcome.notChecked: Whether the cash flows will occur.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] discount-rate.md:12  Discount rate with no basis.
       Fix: State the basis for the rate.
[medium] flow-year-1.csv:19  Cash flow with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the flow.
[low] result-npv.md:26  Result does not match the recomputation.
       Fix: Use the recomputed result.
Not checked: Whether the cash flows will occur.
pros: Checks a cash flow with no source, a discount rate with no basis, and a result that does not match the recomputation.
cons: Not checked: Whether the cash flows will occur.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-fin-investment-appraisal skill on the records for this review.
